question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To go through fire and water
solution:
The correct answer is** 'To face many challenges'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**to go through fire and water**" means to endure or confront numerous difficulties or risks in order to achieve something, in essence, to bravely face many challenges (आग और पानी से गुजरना).
 
• The phrase symbolizes the undergoing of risks or dangers, much like one would experience when passing through fire or water.
 
• Hence, the most fitting meaning of this idiom is **'To face many challenges'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: **"To punish"** means to inflict a penalty or sanction on someone as retribution for an offence (सजा देना).
 
• Option 2:** "To tolerate**" means to allow the existence, occurrence, or practice of something that one dislikes or disagrees with without interference (सहना).
 
• Option 4: **"To do something easy" **is a phrase that means to engage in an activity or task that does not pose much difficulty or challenge
